sections.heading: Wood & Fiber
items: Use a Stone Axe on regular trees; upgrade to a metal axe for hardwood.
Flax Fiber is farmed in Seedbeds. Harvest, replant, and expand plots early for a steady linen supply.
Keep a stockpile of 200+ Wood and 100+ Fiber at your main base for repairs and crafting.

sections.heading: Ore & Stone
items: Stone Pickaxe mines Copper; Iron requires a Copper/Iron pickaxe tier.
Caves and ruins are the best ore sources. Mark them on the map.
Some islands have open iron deposits; others hide them behind boss unlocks.

sections.heading: Leather & Tannin
items: Hunt boars, deer, and predators. Raw hide is processed at the Tanning Rack into Leather.
Tannin is made from Tree Bark at the Alchemy Table. Divi-Divi trees on Foothills Island are a reliable source.
Tanned Leather is the gateway to mid-game armor. Prioritize this after unlocking the Foothills.

sections.heading: Rare Materials
items: Gunpowder ingredients (sulfur, saltpeter) come from caves and coastal deposits.
Tumbaga Ingots require specific ruins and are used for high-tier weapons.
Check community databases for seed-independent resource locations by biome type.
